amenityTypes.name: Clubhouse
amenityTypes.rules:
• No outside catering without prior approval.
  • Deposit refunded within 7 days if no damage.

amenityTypes.name: Pool
amenityTypes.rules:
• Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.
  • No glass containers poolside.

amenityTypes.name: Tennis Court
amenityTypes.rules:
• Non-marking shoes only.
  • Maximum 2-hour booking per unit per day.

amenityTypes.name: Pickleball Court
amenityTypes.rules:
• Shared court — up to 2 bookings per slot.
  • Please vacate promptly at slot end.

amenityTypes.name: Gym
amenityTypes.rules:
• Wipe down equipment after use.
  • No personal trainers without registration.

amenityTypes.name: Party Hall - Banquet 1
amenityTypes.rules:
• Music must end by 22:00.
  • Refundable security deposit required at booking.

amenityTypes.name: Party Hall - Banquet 2
amenityTypes.rules:
• Music off by 22:00.
  • Caterers register at the gate in advance.
  • Hall to be left clean; the deposit is refunded after inspection.

amenityTypes.name: Yoga Room
amenityTypes.rules:
• Book the room for your class or group.
  • Leave mats stacked and the AC off.

amenityTypes.name: Badminton Court
amenityTypes.rules:
• Non-marking shoes only.
  • One hour a day per unit when courts are busy.

amenityTypes.name: Squash Court
amenityTypes.rules:
• Eye protection is compulsory.
  • Close the glass door after play.

amenityTypes.name: Sports Room
amenityTypes.rules: • Table tennis, carrom and indoor games. Return equipment after use.

amenityTypes.name: Baseball Court
amenityTypes.rules: • First come, first served. Share the court.

amenityTypes.name: Cricket Box
amenityTypes.rules: • Tennis ball only. Floodlights switch off at 22:00.
